text:
I published my first Grok @bot template!

Check out Wedding Photo Hunter based on a post I made about using Grok Bot to go through Facebook, find every photo/video from my wedding it can, and download everything into a folder on my computer.

Now anyone can use this template.

https://x.ai/bot/qL6Dww98g_OGhwqDmgvJK

card.title: Wedding Photo Hunter by Alex
card.description: Finds wedding photos by walking the Facebook guest graph from people you already know, then saves them to a folder on your computer.
